source.name: The Daily Tribune (Bahrain), 'Victorious Bahrain goes European: Shaikh Nasser visits Paris FC'

note: Paris FC compete 'under the banner of Victorious Bahrain'; Bahrain took a 20% stake in 2020. The Kingdom became main sponsor at the same time; Sport Stratégies (2020-07-28), citing L'Equipe, reports the €5m Bahrain paid was 'pour acquérir 20 % du capital' (an equity investment via a capital increase), so no separate sponsorship fee has been published and value stays null.
